subject: biology

hotspots.label: Seed coat
hotspots.description: The tough outer protective layer of the seed that shields the embryo and its food.
hotspots.positionHint: The outer shell layer of the broken-open seed.
hotspots.function: Protects the baby plant and food inside.

hotspots.label: Embryo
hotspots.description: The tiny baby plant inside the seed that can grow into a new plant.
hotspots.positionHint: Small plant-shaped core tucked in the seed interior.
hotspots.function: The new plant growing to become mature.

hotspots.label: Stored food
hotspots.description: Food stored around the embryo that gives the seedling its first energy.
hotspots.positionHint: The larger reserve volume filling most of the seed.
hotspots.function: Feeds the seedling until it can make its own food.

hotspots.label: Sprout
hotspots.description: The young root and shoot that push out when the seed germinates.
hotspots.positionHint: Tiny green root and shoot emerging from the base of the seed.
hotspots.function: The young parts that grow into root and stem.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. Clean stylized seed diorama - warm cream-browns and a hint of young green, not cartoon, not cluttered, no glow. Strong color reserved for the hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. No emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single seed cut open, showing a tough outer seed coat, a large stored-food interior, and a small plant-shaped embryo tucked inside, with a tiny green root and shoot emerging at germination. Warm cream-brown seed tones on pale background. Named nodes: SeedCoat, Embryo, StoredFood, Sprout. Budget 10-14k.
